gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Chest Storage & Queued Inscribing
The table saves items inside itself just like a Chest — walk away anytime without losing a thing:
Close the screen, travel far away, or quit and reload the world — gear and materials stay safely inside the table.
During a timed ritual, you can click multiple enchantments on the same item to line them up in a single queue.
While inscribing is running, the target slot stays locked for safety; mining the table drops stored items cleanly.
Hands-Free Crafting
Queue several big enchantments, close the menu to go mining or farming, and come back to finished gear!

[How 'Was Y Levels' is set]: Just like a vanilla Lv.30 table, base gate scales from ~12 up to 30 for max tier (or higher for rare treasures); upgrading existing tiers credits 85% of old progress!
[Use in Green-Orb Mode]: Your entry ticket, NOT full cost! At -40%, 'Was 30' becomes Lv.18 to click — you only spend 1–3 levels and keep XP bar %! This also stops low-level free-XP loops.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Regal-Klassifikation & Rollen
'Bookshelves' fall into clear categories — here is how every type counts across the mod:

[Broad Bookshelves = All 3 Combined]: Includes (1) Regular Bookshelves, (2) Empty Chiseled Bookshelves, and (3) Book-Holding Chiseled Bookshelves (including plain books, grimoires, Enchanted Books, AND Depleted Tomes).
[Book-Holding Chiseled Shelves]: A Chiseled Bookshelf holding plain Books or Depleted Tomes counts as a Broad Bookshelf (not a Master Tome); ONLY Enchanted Books also act as Master Tomes!

[Who Controls What]: Direct upgrade gates, -15% wooden discount, Epiphany (32+) & table book-restoration use Regular Bookshelves; Tome healing (38/42), ritual wait (32+) & slip density use Broad Bookshelves.
Depleted Tomes Keep Your Shelf Tier
If a Master Tome degrades into a Depleted Tome, that Chiseled Bookshelf remains an occupied Broad Bookshelf — your 38/42 healing tier never drops!
